battle.name: 第一次中東戰爭
battle.theater: 巴勒斯坦沿岸平原與耶路撒冷走廊
battle.brief: 一九四八年六月英軍結束對巴勒斯坦的托管，以色列宣布建國，埃及、約旦、敘利亞等國隨即出兵。卡面這件M4謝爾曼中型坦克是當年夏秋以色列用來替換輕型坦克、執行縱深打擊的裝甲骨幹，戰事最終以一九四九年五月至七月間簽訂的停戰協定告終。

kit.name: M4謝爾曼
kit.history: M4謝爾曼是二戰期間美國大量生產的中型坦克，以火力與機動性兼備著稱，成為盟軍裝甲兵力的骨幹。

countries: 交戰的一方是一九四八年五月宣布建國的以色列，另一方是阿拉伯聯盟七個成員國組成的聯軍。以色列在建國之前並沒有常規軍，實際作戰的是哈加納的常備組織、帕爾馬赫的全志願部隊，以及伊爾貢與萊希兩支武裝組織；五月二十六日這四股武裝合併為以色列國防軍，參謀長一職先後由雅科夫·多里與伊加爾·雅丁擔任。作戰序列以旅為骨幹，尼格夫旅、哈雷爾旅（後稱伊夫塔赫旅）、亞歷山德羅尼旅、卡爾梅利旅、第八步兵旅、第八裝甲旅等單位分屬北部、中部與南部三個戰區，海法、耶路撒冷、拉特倫與內格夫四條戰線同時運作。阿拉伯聯軍方面由英軍參謀系統在幕後統一規劃，開羅的中東司令部負責聯軍的協同，英國將軍約翰·巴戈特·格魯布長期指揮約旦的阿拉伯軍團；埃及出動的是巴勒斯坦遠征軍，部隊含第五、第六步兵師，由元帥阿卜杜勒·哈基姆·阿梅爾在開羅統籌，納吉布准將在南部前線直接指揮；約旦的阿拉伯軍團是全軍中機動性最高的一支；敘利亞派出步兵營與炮兵營；伊拉克以一個師的兵力經約旦進入戰場；黎巴嫩與沙烏地阿拉伯只投入象徵性部隊。另有以法烏茲·卡武基為首的阿拉伯解放軍志願兵部隊參戰，其中不少志願者曾在二戰歐洲戰場服役。
countriesEn: One side was Israel, which declared independence in May 1948; the other was the coalition of the seven members of the Arab League. Before independence Israel possessed no regular army at all: the fighting was done by the standing organisation of the Haganah, the all-volunteer forces of the Palmach, and the two armed organisations, the Irgun and Lehi. On 26 May these were merged into the Israel Defence Forces, with the post of chief of staff held first by Yaakov Dori and later by Yigal Yadin. The order of battle was built on brigades: the Negev Brigade, the Har'el Brigade (later called Yiftach), the Alexandroni, Carmeli, 8th Infantry and 8th Armoured Brigades were distributed among northern, central and southern sectors, so that the Haifa, Jerusalem, Latrun and Negev fronts were all live at once. On the Arab side the plan was worked out behind the scenes by the British staff system, with the Middle East Command in Cairo coordinating the coalition; the British general John Bagot Glubb served for a long time as commander of the Arab Legion in Transjordan in the capacity of a British adviser. Egypt sent the Palestinian Expeditionary Force, including the 5th and 6th Infantry Divisions, co-ordinated in Cairo by Marshal Abdel Hakim Amer, with General Mohamed Naguib commanding on the southern front. The Arab Legion of Transjordan was the most mobile formation of the whole coalition; Syria sent infantry and artillery battalions; Iraq brought one division into the campaign through Transjordan; Lebanon and Saudi Arabia contributed only token forces. Alongside them fought the volunteer Army of the Arab Liberation under Fawzi al-Kawuqji, a body that included a number of men who had served on European battlefields during the Second World War.
people: 關鍵人物橫跨兩個戰營。以色列方面，總理兼國防部長大衛·本-古里安在建國前後把哈加納、帕爾馬赫、伊爾貢與萊希捏合成一支軍隊，方向由他決定，因此他決定了這場戰爭打成什麼樣子；首任國防軍參謀長雅科夫·多里在前四個月的連敗中主持重整，十一月由伊加爾·雅丁接任；作戰局長伊加爾·阿隆主導了北部的凱德姆與丹尼兩次攻勢；拉赫馬尼上校以哈雷爾旅第三十六營營長的身分，在拉特倫與錫安山一線頂住了阿拉伯軍團的多次進攻；依扎克·拉賓當時是第八裝甲旅的副指揮官，參與了十月北部的縱深打擊；摩西·達揚主持地圖與情報工作；果爾達·梅厄在一九四八年十一月被派往美國，專責遊說購置武器。阿拉伯一側，埃及國王法魯克是全軍名義上的最高統帥，元帥阿卜杜勒·哈基姆·阿梅爾掌軍事大權，納吉布准將在前線指揮南線；阿拉伯聯盟參謀長伊斯梅爾·西德基負責聯軍協同；約旦的阿拉伯軍團由格魯布統率，參謀長則是英國上校約翰·利奇；敘利亞方面由法烏茲·卡武基率領志願兵攻擊加利利；伊拉克部隊的指揮官是准將塔哈·哈希米。英國最後一任巴勒斯坦托管總督康寧安在五月離任；聯合國調解人福爾克·伯納多特伯爵於一九四八年九月十六日在耶路撒冷遇刺身亡，由拉爾夫·邦奇接手完成停戰談判；美國總統杜魯門與國務卿馬歇爾則面對武器禁運與全面援助之間的取捨。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities sat on both sides. On the Israeli side, Prime Minister and Minister of Defence David Ben-Gurion fused the Haganah, the Palmach, the Irgun and Lehi into a single army around the moment of independence, and since he fixed the direction of that army he also fixed the character of the war. The first chief of staff of the IDF, Yaakov Dori, presided over the reconstruction during the first four months of defeat and was replaced in November by Yigal Yadin. The head of operations, Yigal Allon, directed the Kedem and Dani offensives in the north. Colonel Yiftach Rachmani, commanding the 36th Battalion of the Har'el Brigade, absorbed repeated assaults by the Arab Legion on the Latrun and Mount Zion line. Yitzhak Rabin was then deputy commander of the 8th Armoured Brigade and took part in the deep penetrations of the north in October. Moshe Dayan ran the map and intelligence branches, and Golda Meir was sent to the United States in November 1948 with the specific task of lobbying for arms. On the Arab side the King of Egypt, Farouk, was the nominal commander-in-chief of the whole coalition, while Marshal Abdel Hakim Amer held the military power and General Mohamed Naguib commanded the southern front. Ismail Sidky, chief of staff of the Arab League, was responsible for coalition coordination. The Arab Legion was commanded by Glubb with the British colonel John Leach as its chief of staff, the Syrian contingent was led by Fawzi al-Kawuqji with his volunteers, and the Iraqi forces were under Brigadier General Taha al-Hashimi. Sir Alan Cunningham, the last British High Commissioner in Palestine, left his post in May. The United Nations mediator Count Folke Bernadotte was assassinated in Jerusalem on 16 September 1948 and was succeeded by Ralph Bunche, who carried the armistice negotiations to the end. President Truman and Secretary of State Marshall in Washington were left to choose between an arms embargo and open support.
kits: 卡面這件M4謝爾曼中型坦克於一九四二年在美國大量生產，乘員五人，戰鬥全重約三十噸，四百五十匹馬力的汽油機推動，公路最高時速約四十公里，裝有七十五毫米戰鬥車炮與同軸機槍，到一九四八年已是全球最普及的裝甲車型之一。以色列在戰爭初期幾乎沒有可用坦克，哈加納與帕爾馬赫裝備的是M3、M5史都華等輕型坦克與M22洛克斯特微型坦克；一九四八年五月首批美運軍火抵達海法港，其中包含為數不多的M4A1E2簡易八型謝爾曼，正面裝甲加厚至八十九毫米，六挺重機槍與新型供彈機構使它在近距離火力上佔優，第八裝甲旅在一九四八年夏秋整編時以它替換部分輕型坦克，十月北部的凱德姆與丹尼作戰中，謝爾曼縱隊正是突破正面與迂迴側翼的主力。埃及軍序列中同樣有為數不多的M4A1謝爾曼、M5A1史都華輕坦克、M8灰狗偵察車與M10沃爾弗林戰車殲滅車，全部來自戰前的美軍剩餘清售。阿拉伯軍團則是英式裝備，配六磅炮、二十五磅野戰炮、維克斯六噸輕型坦克與裝甲車。共同裝備方面，以軍有M3半履帶車、通用吉普、M1加德蘭與李-恩菲德步槍、M2勃朗寧重機槍、迫擊炮與英製六磅炮；埃及與約旦有英製二十五磅炮與法製輕機槍；一九四八年九月捷克斯洛伐克還售予以色列二十三架Avia S-199戰鬥機與數架B-25轟炸機，而英美在此之前對中東的武器禁運幾乎切斷了雙方的補充來源。
kitsEn: The M4 Sherman on the card face was mass-produced in the United States from 1942 onwards. It carried a crew of five, weighed some thirty tonnes in combat order, and was driven by a 450-horsepower petrol engine for a road speed of about forty kilometres per hour, armed with a 75mm tank gun and a coaxial machine gun; by 1948 it was one of the most widely used armoured types in the world. Israel possessed almost no usable tanks at the start of the war: the Haganah and the Palmach were equipped with light tanks of the M3 and M5 Stuart family and with the tiny M22 Locust. The first American shipment of arms reached the port of Haifa in May 1948 and included a small number of M4A1E2 Easy Eight Shermans, with frontal armour thickened to eighty-nine millimetres and six heavy machine guns behind a new feed system, which gave them an edge at close quarters. The 8th Armoured Brigade was re-equipped with them during the summer and autumn of 1948, replacing part of its light tank strength, and in the Kedem and Dani operations of October the Sherman columns were the main striking force on the breakthrough front and on the turning flanks. The Egyptian order of battle likewise contained a small number of M4A1 Shermans, M5A1 Stuarts, M8 Greyhound scout cars and M10 Wolverine tank destroyers, all of them bought as American surplus after the war. The Arab Legion was equipped in the British manner, with 6-pounder and 25-pounder guns, Vickers six-ton light tanks and armoured cars. In the way of common equipment the Israeli army had M3 half-tracks, jeeps, M1 Garand and Lee-Enfield rifles, M2 Browning heavy machine guns, mortars and British 6-pounders; Egypt and Transjordan had British 25-pounders and French light machine guns. In September 1948 Czechoslovakia sold Israel twenty-three Avia S-199 fighters and several B-25 bombers, and until then the Anglo-American arms embargo had almost cut off the resupply of both sides.
tactics: 阿拉伯聯軍的作戰方法是英式正面戰：密集縱隊在炮兵掩護下沿公路與鐵路推進，逐點攻取城鎮與高地，補給與後續梯隊拉得很長，敘利亞方向沒有鐵路通到巴勒斯坦，全靠卡車與馬車輸送；一九四八年六月的入圍計畫是要在沿海與內陸同時壓上，切斷特拉維夫通往耶路撒冷的公路，把以軍分割在三段，其中埃及軍的目標是占領耶路撒冷與阿尤什一帶的丘陵地帶，敘利亞軍攻加利利，約旦的阿拉伯軍團負責向耶路撒冷與約旦河方向推進。以軍這邊則完全相反：一九四八年六月八日夜的橋樑之夜，哈雷爾旅第三十五營以舟橋強渡蘇卡河，在拉特倫以南建立灘頭；全軍以夜戰與側翼迂迴為主，重裝甲集中於一點突破，步兵依托村莊、果園與丘陵反擊；帕爾馬赫的汽車縱隊在內格夫沙漠中以輕戰車與吉普長途追擊；英方在七月曾以C-47向耶路撒冷舊城空投補給，以方也以空運把軍火自海法運往內陸；一九四八年九月十六日，以軍一支小分隊夜襲貝魯特市區，摧毀政府機關與火車站以打擊聯盟的縱深。總體而言，聯軍靠人數與火炮的正面壓制，以軍靠夜間機動、裝甲縱深打擊與臨時空運維持戰線。
tacticsEn: The coalition fought in the British manner, head-on: dense columns advanced along roads and railways under covering fire, taking towns and high ground point by point, while supply and follow-up echelons stretched a long way back, and the Syrian axis had no railway into Palestine at all, so everything moved by truck and wagon. The plan for June 1948 was to press in simultaneously from the coast and from the interior, cut the road from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem and split the Israeli army into three separate segments. The Egyptian objective was the hill country around Jerusalem and al-Auja, the Syrian army was to take the Galilee, and the Arab Legion was to push towards Jerusalem and the Jordan. The Israeli army worked in exactly the opposite way. On the night of 8 June 1948, the Night of the Bridges, the 35th Battalion of the Har'el Brigade forced the Sorek river on a pontoon bridge and established a bridgehead south of Latrun. Night fighting and turning of the flank were the house style, massed armour was concentrated on a single point of breakthrough, and infantry held villages, orchards and hills and answered from them. Palmach columns of cars, light tanks and jeeps pursued the enemy deep into the sands of the Negev. The British flew supplies into the Old City of Jerusalem by C-47 in July, and the Israelis likewise lifted arms from Haifa inland by air. On 16 September 1948 an Israeli detachment raided central Beirut at night, wrecking government offices and the railway station in an attempt to strike the coalition's rear. In broad strokes the coalition relied on numbers and massed artillery in frontal pressure, while Israel held the line through night mobility, armoured depth attacks and improvised airlift.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下，但各方統計互相矛盾，只能取其量級。以軍在開戰時的武裝人員一般記為三萬人上下，其中哈加納逾一萬人、帕爾馬赫約三千五百人、伊爾貢與萊希合計數千人；阿拉伯聯盟首批投入兵力約二萬三千五百至二萬六千五百人。經過六月十一日起為期四週的停火，以軍總兵力增至六萬五千人上下，阿拉伯方面到一九四九年也增至六、七萬人。損失方面，以色列軍方陣亡約六千人，阿拉伯各國軍隊陣亡一般記為一萬五千人左右，但部分數字把非戰鬥減員與後續戰役一併計入，爭議頗大。作戰物資方面，以色列在戰爭期間經海運與空運自美國取得約四萬五千噸軍械與七千餘輛汽車，內含M4A1E2謝爾曼等坦克、迫擊炮與半履帶車；一九四八年十月凱德姆作戰推進的縱深超過六十公里，最遠處抵達距海法約三十公里的凱法拉希夫。停戰的時間點則明確：以色列與約旦於一九四九年四月二十三日停火，與黎巴嫩於七月十九日、與敘利亞於七月二十日停火，埃及與以色列的停戰協定則在二月二十四日簽訂。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are roughly as follows, though the sources contradict one another and only the order of magnitude can be relied on. The Israeli armed personnel at the opening of the war are generally given as about thirty thousand, of whom the Haganah numbered more than ten thousand, the Palmach about three thousand five hundred and the Irgun and Lehi several thousand between them. The coalition committed between twenty-three thousand five hundred and twenty-six thousand five hundred men in the first offensive. After the four-week truce that began on 11 June the Israeli total rose to some sixty-five thousand, and the Arab side reached sixty or seventy thousand by 1949. On losses, Israeli military dead are put at about six thousand, and the military dead of the Arab states are commonly given as around fifteen thousand, although some of those totals fold in non-battle attrition and later campaigns, and the dispute over them is sharp. In materiel, Israel received from the United States by sea and by air roughly forty-five thousand tonnes of ordnance and more than seven thousand vehicles during the war, including M4A1E2 Shermans and other tanks, mortars and half-tracks. In the Kedem operation of October 1948 the advance went deeper than sixty kilometres, reaching Kafr Yasif, some thirty kilometres from Haifa. The timing of the ceasefires, by contrast, is exact: Israel and Transjordan ceased fire on 23 April 1949, Lebanon on 19 July, Syria on 20 July, and the Egyptian-Israeli armistice agreement was signed on 24 February.
cause: 起因可以分三層。最外層是政治決定：一九四七年十一月二十九日聯合國大會以三十三票通過第一八一號決議案，把巴勒斯坦托管地劃分為猶太國家與阿拉伯國家兩部分，英國無力執行，托管當局在一九四八年上半年已形同癱瘓。中間一層是暴力升級：一九四七年底起兩個社區的武裝組織互相襲擊，一九四八年春以軍攻擊耶路撒冷附近村莊的事件在英美兩國引起強烈反應，聯邦政府於三月二十日宣布對中東實施武器禁運，反而令以軍在開戰時彈藥不足，條件艱困。最內層是阿拉伯聯盟的協同計畫：一九四八年三月十日開羅會議決定出兵，三個方向同時進攻，意圖在猶太國家立國之初將其消滅；敘利亞與伊拉克主張把戰事進行到底，而埃及與約旦主張在劃分方案的基礎上建立巴勒斯坦的阿拉伯國家，聯盟內部的分歧直到開戰之後都沒有完全化解。英國在一九四八年五月初撤出最後一批托管人員，戰爭因此失去任何過渡安排。
causeEn: The causes fall into three layers. The outermost is a political decision: on 29 November 1947 the United Nations General Assembly passed Resolution 181 by thirty-three votes, partitioning the territory of the Mandate for Palestine into a Jewish state and an Arab state. Britain was unable to implement it, and the Mandate administration was already close to paralysis in the first half of 1948. The middle layer is the escalation of violence: from late 1947 the armed organisations of the two communities struck at each other, and the Israeli raid on a village near Jerusalem in the spring of 1948 produced such strong reaction in Britain and the United States that the federal government imposed an arms embargo on the Middle East on 20 March, which left the Israeli army short of ammunition at the opening of the war and its conditions desperately hard. The innermost layer is the coordinated plan of the Arab League: the Cairo conference of 10 March 1948 resolved to attack from three directions at once with the intention of extinguishing the Jewish state at the moment of its birth. Syria and Iraq wanted the campaign carried through, while Egypt and Transjordan wanted an Arab state of Palestine built on the basis of the partition plan, and the disagreements inside the League were never fully settled even after the fighting began. Britain withdrew its last Mandate officials in early May 1948, and the war was thus left without any transitional arrangement at all.
impact: 影響延續至今。軍事與領土上，以色列從建國時實際控制不到三分之一的托管地，擴大到停戰線內約五分之四的面積，耶路撒冷被分割為兩部分，西城與走廊歸以色列，舊城與約旦河西岸歸約旦，加沙地帶歸埃及管理，一九四八年九月二十二日以色列臨時國務委員會通過《管轄區域和權力條例》，把佔領地自動劃入國家版圖。人口上，大批巴勒斯坦平民離家背井，成為延續數十年的流離問題。政治上，這場戰爭把以色列牢牢綁在美國的援助上，也讓阿拉伯國家分成以埃及為中心與以敘利亞、伊拉克為中心的兩派；埃及雖然在戰役上失利，但阿拉伯聯盟的總部設在開羅，阿拉伯各國之間的合作機制反而因這次共同出兵而得到強化。冷戰格局上，這是第一場大規模的美蘇代理衝突，武器禁運的鬆動與美援的到來，讓中東從英法的勢力範圍轉成超級大國較勁的場所。聯合國成立停戰監督團，使停戰線成為此後每一次中東衝突的固定框架。
impactEn: The consequences run to this day. Militarily and territorially, Israel went from controlling less than a third of the Mandate territory at independence to roughly four-fifths of it inside the armistice lines. Jerusalem was divided in two, the western city and the corridor going to Israel, the Old City and the West Bank to Transjordan, and the Gaza strip to Egyptian administration; on 22 September 1948 the provisional government of Israel passed the Area and Jurisdiction Ordinance, which drew occupied territory automatically into the borders of the state. In demographic terms, large numbers of Palestinian civilians were uprooted from their homes, and that displacement became a problem lasting for decades. Politically, the war bound Israel firmly to American assistance and split the Arab states into an Egyptian camp and a Syrian-Iraqi camp; although Egypt was militarily defeated, the headquarters of the Arab League were in Cairo, and the machinery of Arab cooperation was strengthened rather than weakened by the common campaign. In the Cold War pattern this was the first large proxy conflict between the superpowers; the loosening of the embargo and the arrival of American aid turned the Middle East from a British and French sphere into a place where the superpowers competed. The United Nations created a truce supervision organisation, and the armistice lines became the fixed frame for every later Middle Eastern conflict.
result: 結局是以色列大勝、阿拉伯聯軍敗退，但沒有任何一方取得和平條約。埃及遠征軍在拉特倫與內格夫被逐步逐回，敘利亞軍在加利利丟失據點，約旦的阿拉伯軍團退守約旦河東岸，聯軍失去了除加沙與約旦河西岸以外的全部巴勒斯坦控制區；一九四九年三月，以軍在付出重大代價後攻入拉特倫據點，埃及軍隨即以反攻奪回，拉特倫直到停火都沒有長久落入以軍之手。以色列總計占據托管地約五分之四的土地，海法、耶路撒冷走廊與內格夫的主要城鎮連成一條縱深，內格夫在十二月的攻勢中推進至阿里什與拉法一線，埃軍節節退向加沙與埃及本土。以色列在戰役層面獲勝，卻只拿到停戰協定而非條約；停戰線在此後數十年成為下一次戰爭的引爆點，一九四九年之後的每一次中東衝突，幾乎都是沿著這些線重新開打。
resultEn: The outcome was a decisive Israeli victory and a rout of the Arab coalition, but not one side obtained a peace treaty. The Egyptian Expeditionary Force was driven back step by step from Latrun and the Negev, the Syrian army lost its positions in the Galilee, and the Arab Legion withdrew to the east bank of the Jordan, leaving the coalition in control of nothing in Palestine except Gaza and the West Bank. In March 1949 the Israeli army stormed the Latrun positions at heavy cost, and the Egyptian army immediately retook them by counter-attack; Latrun never remained long in Israeli hands before the ceasefire. Israel ended the war holding about four-fifths of the Mandate territory, Haifa, the Jerusalem corridor and the main towns of the Negev were linked into a single line of depth; the December offensive in the Negev pushed forward to the Aleish and the Rafah line, and the Egyptian army fell back towards Gaza and the Egyptian homeland. Israel won at the level of the campaign but obtained an armistice rather than a treaty, and the armistice lines of 1949 became the flashpoint of every later war: almost every Middle Eastern conflict after 1949 was fought along the same lines.
